title: A stack batch keeps its shape after the Foreman's compactions
summary: Spec v2: asks refuses a per-CR ready-to-merge in a stack batch while another CR has an open PR or a stacked CR is open (fix CR excepted; --outside-stack "O-k: ..." on the user's word); status --refresh shape line; stack rules move to foreman-stack.md; CoS sends mismatched asks back.
